title: Information Collection, Use and Sharing
content:
We are the sole owners of information collected on Realityworks.com. We do not sell information to any party outside of our organization.

We may contact you via email in the future to tell you about specials, new products or services, or changes to this privacy policy. You may change your preferences or opt out of communications with us at any time using the unsubscribe link provided in our email communications.

title: Your Access To And Control Over Information
content:
You may opt out of future contact with us at any time. You can do so by contacting us via email at information@realityworks.com or by calling 1-800-830-1416.

See what data we have about you, if any.
Change or correct any data we have about you.
Request that we delete any data we have about you.
Express any concerns you have about our use of your data.

title: Security
content:
We take precautions to protect your information. When you submit sensitive information via Realityworks.com, your information is protected both online and offline.

When we collect sensitive information, such as credit card details, that information is encrypted and transmitted to us securely. You can verify this by looking for the closed lock icon in your web browser or by ensuring that the website address begins with https at the beginning of your website address.
While we use encryption to protect sensitive information transmitted online, we also safeguard your information offline. Only employees who need the information to perform specific job-related duties, such as billing or customer service, are granted access to personally identifiable information. The computers and servers used to store personally identifiable information are maintained in a secure environment.

title: Using Realityworks' Products
content:
Some of our products require login and registration information. This information enables you to collect simulation statistics based on your program needs. We do not collect your login and registration information for marketing purposes, nor do we share this information.

Some of our products utilize third-party platforms to operate. How those third-party platforms collect and use login and registration information is up to the individual platforms.

title: Registration
content: In order to use certain areas of this website, you must first complete a registration form. During registration, you are required to provide certain information, such as your name and email address. This information is used to contact you about the products and services on our site in which you have expressed interest.

title: Orders
content:
We request information from you on our order form. To buy from us, you must provide contact information, such as your name and shipping address, as well as financial information, such as a credit card number. This information is used solely for billing and order fulfillment purposes. If we have trouble processing an order, we'll use this information to contact you.

We use an outside credit card processing company to bill users for goods and services purchased via credit card. These companies do not retain, share, store, or use personally identifiable information for any secondary purposes beyond fulfilling your order.

title: Cookies And Analytics
content:
Realityworks.com uses two web analytics platforms to track the information and behavior of our website users: Sugar Market and Google Analytics. Sugar Market tracks individual interaction with Realityworks.com. Google Analytics tracks single web sessions.

Both of these web analytics platforms are enabled through the use of cookies. Cookies (also known as HTTP cookies, web cookies, or browser cookies) are small pieces of data sent from a website and stored in a user's web browser while a user is browsing a website. Cookies do not expire.

title: Links
content: This website contains links to other sites. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of other sites. We encourage our users to be aware when they leave our site and to read the privacy statements of any other site that collects personally identifiable information.

title: Surveys & Contests
content: We occasionally request information via surveys or contests. Requested information may include contact information, like name and address, and demographic information, like zip code and age level. Contact information will be used to notify contest winners and award prizes. Survey information will be used for purposes of monitoring or improving the use and satisfaction of our products, programs, website and other areas of Realityworks. Participation in these surveys or contests is voluntary. You may change your preferences or opt out of communications with us at any time using the unsubscribe link provided in our email communications.

title: Questions
content: We welcome questions, comments and concerns about our privacy policy and privacy practices. If you wish to provide feedback, ask a question, share a concern or exercise your rights related to your personal data, please contact our team at information@realityworks.com or 1-800-380-1416.
